items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: he took it upstairs and listened to it and came back down and handed it to me and told me, take it to Larry McKenna, tell him, put it on.

ctx.x: Yeah. And when Eddie gave me that tune, he gave me a poem. A poem? Yeah, but he had a melody. But it was, you know, he had written. In fact, I still have it somewhere here. I know I have it. And it was a ballad. Mm-hmm. Very slow ballad. And after I learned the thing, I couldn't really, I liked everything about it, but I couldn't get nothing out of the song being a ballad. Right. And so, I'm the one that responded for it being with the tempo it is because I had to change it. You changed the tempo. Yeah. It just…
